propositions: Upper-bound wall-clock assertions in tests cause CI flake under runner contention; a detector regex + escape rules prototype caught all instances with zero false positives.

Detector must block new unescaped upper-bound asserts as a DET code-review gate criterion, with teaching message naming both valid escapes: reasoned '# timing: hang-guard' marker or skipif-CI perf-lane guard.

Two test migration sites must replace upper-bound asserts with spy-based counting proxies: test_config_perf.py spying config._ordered_layers for cache hits, and test_enrich_drain.py counting pending_enrichment probes.
Remaining nine in-scope sites must carry reasoned hang-guard markers; detector run must be clean (exit 0) at landing.
Detector unit tests must cover fire cases, both escapes (marker and skipif-CI guard), bare @pytest.mark.benchmark NOT escaping, lower-bound exclusion, and self-exclusion via EXCLUDED_FILES idiom.
